request.text: One single tiny rounded water droplet with a warm delicate glass resonance, a soft musical A4 note. Immediate gentle pluck at time zero, short clean decay into silence. Intimate, tactile, tranquil, almost ASMR. Not a cartoon pop or a computer beep. No background ambience or music. No voices, no speech, no harsh transients, no distortion. Original isolated sound design for a soothing microscopic pond-life game.
